title: YC deal announcement: 12 months free for YC founders
summary: YC founders get 12 months free on Asteroid to ship production browser agents on legacy portals with no API, HIPAA-ready and SOC 2. Claim the YC deal.
body_markdown:

**Details here:**[Asteroid YC Deal](https://deals.ycombinator.com/deals/3308)


## Why This Matters - Especially for Healthcare and Insurance


### Skip the API Backlog


We’ve connected to dozens of EHRs, CRMs, and insurance carriers in **days, not months** .


### Production First


Our browser agents automate mission-critical workflows—from quoting and eligibility checks to EHR updates and claims workflows—with human oversight for reliability.


### Compliance Baked In


We’re **HIPAA-compliant** and **SOC 2 Type 2** , so you can move fast without getting blocked by security reviews.


## The Unfair Advantage


YC founders tell us the early days are where this shines: we act as an engineering extension of your team to get agents into production this week, giving you the operations superpowers incumbents built over a decade— **without their headcount or timelines** .


## Use Cases We See Repeatedly


- **Push/pull data from EHR portals** when vendors won’t prioritize your integration
- **Automate insurance quoting and status checks** across multiple carrier portals
- **Connect voice/chat agents to backend portals** via browser actions instead of brittle glue code
- **Automate freight and supply chain workflows** in legacy carrier and TMS portals
- **Standardize back-office tasks** (forms, uploads, audits) across systems with zero APIs


## Launch in Hours, Not Months


If you’re building in healthcare, insurance, supply chain, or anywhere with stubborn legacy portals, this is the unfair advantage: **launch your first automation in hours** , learn from real usage, then decide what’s worth a deeper integration later.
